summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long BB Daily ETF (BBUL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB) stock. BBUL was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.

data.title: Risky leveraged ETFs are booming in 2026. Some worry they could be making the stock market more volatile.
data.text: Some say traders who gravitate toward these products see big swings in the underlying stocks as a feature, not a bug.

data.title: GraniteShares Launches BBUL and PUL, 2x Long ETFs on BlackBerry and Everpure
data.text: New single-stock ETFs give investors amplified leveraged daily participation tied to BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB) and Everpure, Inc. (NYSE: P)
